title: Underground hip-hop
description: Umbrella term for hip-hop that rejects mainstream aesthetics
extract: Underground hip-hop is a scene and style of hip-hop music that is defined as being countercultural in nature, existing outside of and in contrast to the sounds, style and aesthetics of mainstream hip-hop. Despite this, underground artists have often reached widespread success and popularity through internet virality, critical acclaim, or appearances on the Billboard charts.
